sb_prompt: DISCUSS PLANNING A FAMILY REUNION.  DRAW ON YOUR EXPERIENCES AND THOSE OF THE OTHER CALLER FOR MAKING THE NEXT GET-TOGETHER SUCCESSFUL AND MEMORABLE.
turns: So, what's been on your mind lately?
Well, I've been thinking about planning a family reunion.
Yeah, I think it's about time we got everyone together.
I had a family reunion last year, it was a lot of fun, but it was also a lot of work.
Yeah, I'm sure it will be too.
What's your plan for the reunion?
I'm thinking of having it at a park near my house.
Have you thought about invitations and how you'll send them out?
I haven't decided yet, but I'm thinking of sending out email invitations.
I actually used a website to create and send out invitations for my last reunion, it was really easy and convenient.
That sounds like a good idea.
I also made a family tree to include everyone and their contact information.
What's the size of your family?
It's about twenty people, including cousins and extended family.
I also made a list of activities and games for everyone to enjoy during the reunion.
What kind of activities and games did you have at your reunion?
We had a photo scavenger hunt, a trivia game about family history, and a picnic lunch.
That sounds like a lot of fun.
We also had a family talent show where everyone performed something they were good at.
We should definitely do something like that too.
And we also had a potluck dinner where everyone brought a dish to share.
Yeah, I think we should definitely do a potluck too.
Have you thought about what you'll serve for food at the reunion?
I was thinking of having burgers and hot dogs for the main meal, but I'm open to other suggestions.
Maybe we could also have a dessert contest where everyone brings their best homemade dessert to share.
Yeah, that sounds like a good idea.
Have you thought about a date and time for the reunion yet?
Actually, my cousin mentioned that she's free that weekend, so I was thinking about scheduling it for then.
That sounds like a good time for everyone to come together.
What are some of the activities and games you're planning to include at the reunion?
We could also have a family history quiz and a game of trivia about our ancestors.
That sounds like a great idea.
We could also have a game of cornhole.
What about a family photo scavenger hunt?
Yeah, that sounds like fun too.
Have you thought about decorations or any special touches for the reunion?
Yeah, I was thinking of decorating the picnic area with balloons and streamers.
